summary: Structural twin of TextAttributeLookup (004133b0): text attribute field lookup restricted to a single field selector. Fetches the attribute record at index a3 through LinkedListIndexedAccessor_56c0. Only when the record is non-null and a2 == 1 does it copy the string path and metadata from a record slot (record+0x34, or record+0x48 when a4==0) into the output struct at a1, with null path falling back to byte_5EA438. Regardless of the copy path, the output string is normalized to byte_5EA438 and the same sentinel test as 004133b0 decides the result: -1 when all output fields are default (string equals byte_5EA438, metadata == -1/-1, byte field == 0), else 1.

local_names.a1: output attribute struct (string path + 3 metadata fields)
local_names.a3: record index into the attribute list
local_names.a4: variant selector switching between two slot offsets
local_names.v4: attribute record pointer from the list

operations.description: Fetch attribute record at index a3 via LinkedListIndexedAccessor_56c0.
Only proceed to the copy path when the record is non-null and a2 == 1; every other case skips straight to the default-string/sentinel tail.
Select record slot: record+0x34, or record+0x48 when a4==0.
Read string path pointer from the slot, falling back to the default string byte_5EA438 when the slot pointer is null.
Copy the selected path string into the output buffer via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc.
Copy slot metadata into the output struct: out+0x08 = slot+0x08, out+0x0C = slot+0x0C, out+0x10 = slot+0x10 (byte).
Normalize the output string to the default byte_5EA438 via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc on the missing-record or out-of-range path.
Sentinel test on the output struct: string at out+0x00 equals byte_5EA438 (falling back to the default when the pointer is null) and out+0x08 == -1 and out+0x0C == -1 and out+0x10 == 0.
Return -1 when every output field still holds its default sentinel value, otherwise 1.
